solution.text:
Given complex number is z=3+2isinθ1-2isinθ

⇒z=(3+2isinθ)(1+2isinθ)(1+4sin2θ)

Since given complex number is purely imaginary

⇒Re(z)=0

⇒3-4sin2θ=0

⇒sinθ=±32

⇒θ=-π3,π3,2π3

⇒ sum of all possible values of θ=2π3 .
